_meta.scale: 0-1 holistic lesson quality = completeness + backward-design coherence (objective <-> instruction <-> assessment) + richness of the lesson as actually written
_meta.note: PROVISIONAL. These `quality` values were seeded by an agent reading each lesson's Layer 0 elements — they are a grounded starting point, NOT confirmed human ground truth. A curriculum SME should review each lesson, correct `quality`, and set `needs_confirmation` to false. The bake-off ranks scoring methods by agreement with these values, so corrections here can change which method wins; confirm before the lock-in step.

67a41a913430.title: Manufacturing Lesson
67a41a913430.rationale: All eight instructional parts present and coherent: clear objective (explore manufacturing via experiential learning), hook, direct instruction + guided build (10-block model), a research-showcase assessment, and a reflection/closure. Rich, aligned lesson.

89430d6aae63.title: Arts AV Technology Communication - Slides
89430d6aae63.rationale: 16 elements, full instructional arc, engaging opener (Guess the Logo), substantive content (career definitions, job roles, district pathways) with checks. Strong, complete slide lesson.

3dc5933c971d.title: Teaching and Training Education and Training Lesson Plan
3dc5933c971d.rationale: Has objective, instruction, guided practice, a peer-review assessment with materials, and closure — but much of the content is repeated 'Question Stems' text across sections, so it is complete yet thin/repetitive.

4b97944cd264.title: Engineering Lesson
4b97944cd264.rationale: Clear engineering-design objective (paper airplane), strong hook (aircraft carrier), explain (potential/kinetic energy) and a design/explore activity. Coherent and rich, but no explicit assessment or closure element.

4cc88ad60178.title: Hospitality Tourism - Lesson Plan
4cc88ad60178.rationale: Lots of material (19 elements) with engaging resources (Masterchef clip, knife-cut video) and some instruction/guided/assessment, but loosely structured — many elements are 'unclear', so coherence is middling.

48a445a553cc.title: Career Cluster - Lesson Plan
48a445a553cc.rationale: Only objective + 'unclear' engagement question stems are identifiable; no clearly structured instruction or assessment. Weak as a standalone teachable lesson.

3a729a90b236.title: Business Marketing Finance Lesson Plan
3a729a90b236.rationale: Essentially a skeleton: a career-table header and a bare 'Day 1 / Day 2 / Day 3' line. Almost no lesson content present.
